records.matter: U.S. Attorney removal after resisting political pressure over case timing
records.institution: U.S. Department of Justice / U.S. Attorney’s Office for the District of New Mexico
records.qualification_basis_status: Senate-confirmed federal prosecutor with positive office evaluations and decision authority over charging and investigative timing

source_packets.supports: DOJ OIG and OPR published a joint investigation into the removal of nine U.S. Attorneys.

The report found David Iglesias had positive evaluations, was pressured concerning election-related cases, was removed because of complaints about his handling of those matters, and was later described through management rationales the investigators found after-the-fact.
The report found misleading statements and incomplete disclosure concerning the reasons for the removals and White House involvement.

records.source_supports: The official packet supplies a bounded prosecutorial judgment, political complaints about its timing, removal authority, and a documented after-the-fact management justification.
source_does_not_establish: every participant’s motive or knowledge
a private psychological inability to comprehend prosecutorial judgment
a complete correction or remedy record for Iglesias
independent second-party K0 adjudication

records.matter: Inspector General resignation after a critical compliance report and feared board termination
records.qualification_basis_status: Inspector General charged with independent audit and investigation under the WMATA compact and board policy

source_packets.supports: GAO reported that a former WMATA IG said he resigned after a critical report because he believed the Board Chair would terminate him; GAO also found missing removal procedures and risks from annual renewal terms.

records.source_supports: GAO documents critical reporting, a negative board response described by the former IG, anticipated termination, resignation, and structural board control over removal and renewal.
source_does_not_establish: that the Board formally ordered removal
the Board’s complete contemporaneous reasons
a completed material removal rather than anticipated termination and resignation
a complete K0 explanation-mutation chain

records.matter: Amtrak Inspector General forced-retirement ultimatum during an investigation
records.qualification_basis_status: Statutory Inspector General with an oversight mandate and reported record of investigations into Amtrak management

source_packets.supports: A congressional minority staff report said the Amtrak board used a 24-hour retire-or-face-public-allegations ultimatum, failed to notify Congress, and acted around an investigation; it characterized the removal as undermining OIG independence.

records.source_supports: The packet identifies a bounded board personnel gate, an oversight investigation, an ultimatum, and an asserted checking-function replacement.
source_does_not_establish: a bipartisan or judicial merits finding
the full board record and all asserted reasons
that every allegation in the minority staff report is independently established
a complete K0 causal chain rather than a governance and statutory-compliance dispute

records.matter: Order to remove a special prosecutor after contrary subpoena judgment and refusal by the Attorney General
records.institution: Executive Branch / Department of Justice during Watergate
records.qualification_basis_status: Special Prosecutor exercising subpoena authority and Attorney General responsible for lawful execution of presidential direction

source_packets.supports: The chronology records Cox’s refusal of the Stennis compromise, Nixon’s order that Richardson fire Cox, Richardson’s refusal and resignation, and Bork’s firing of Cox.

records.source_supports: The official chronology supplies contrary legal/prosecutorial judgment, a direct removal order, refusal by an intermediate gateholder, resignation, and eventual removal of the checking actor.
source_does_not_establish: private psychological incomprehension rather than strategic bypass
the full evidentiary record of each actor’s legal reasoning
that Richardson’s resignation removed every source of correction
a field-adjudicated CCD value

records.matter: Inspector General removal accompanied by an identified ongoing misconduct inquiry and statutory notice controversy
records.qualification_basis_status: Presidentially removable Inspector General subject to statutory notice and substantive-rationale requirements

source_packets.supports: CRS records the 2024 removal notice for the Railroad Retirement Board IG, states that more information about an ongoing misconduct investigation was supplied than in prior notices, and preserves criticism that the rationale remained inadequate.

records.source_supports: This comparator preserves a removal tied to an identified investigative process and statutory notice dispute rather than assuming every checking-function removal follows contrary advice.
source_does_not_establish: the truth of the misconduct allegations
that statutory notice was legally sufficient
the absence of political considerations
a qualified contradiction or competence reclassification

records.matter: Commanding officer relief after a grounding investigation produced sufficient factual findings
records.qualification_basis_status: Commanding officer subject to operational accountability and command investigation

source_packets.supports: The Navy states that relief followed an investigation into a soft grounding and that sufficient findings of fact had emerged to warrant relief.

records.source_supports: The record provides a lawful-removal comparator grounded in an operational investigation rather than a documented expert contradiction.
source_does_not_establish: the complete investigation file
that all military loss-of-confidence removals are justified
a contradiction or explanation mutation
a K0 event

records.matter: Inspector General removal law requiring advance rationale and continuity reporting
records.qualification_basis_status: Statutory congressional-notice, rationale, non-duty-status, and ongoing-work continuity rules

source_packets.supports: CRS describes 30-day written notice with detailed case-specific rationale, restrictions on non-duty status, and reporting concerning ongoing OIG projects after removal.

records.source_supports: The control separates political appointment authority from unreviewable removal by preserving reasons, notice, inquiry context, and ongoing-work continuity.
source_does_not_establish: that notice prevents every retaliatory removal
that Congress can always stay a removal
that reasons supplied are truthful
a final merits decision in any candidate

records.matter: Official clarification that a senior military adviser retained statutory status despite governance-structure confusion
records.qualification_basis_status: Statutory senior military adviser and public institutional clarification

source_packets.supports: Defense officials stated that an executive memorandum did not diminish the Chairman’s statutory advisory authority and that attendance language continued longstanding policy.

records.source_supports: The retained query result shows that an apparent exclusion or replacement signal may resolve as continuity of advisory authority rather than removal.
source_does_not_establish: a later removal event
that advisory access was never contested in other settings
a contrary advice sequence
a K0 event
